sections.Profile:
The "Nags" pinball machine, manufactured by Williams in 1960, is a unique and highly collectible electro-mechanical game known for its horse racing theme. One of its standout features is the mechanical horse race animation in the backbox, where six horses compete towards the finish line, triggered primarily by the corresponding pop bumpers on the playfield.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Horse Racing
